title: Releases
subtitle: Every cycle in flight, what it still needs, and what it took to ship the last one.
deleteConfirm: Delete release {version}? Its checklist and history go with it. Tasks scoped into it are kept and unscoped.
emptyBody: Adjust the filters, or plan the next cycle from a product page.

scope.title: Scope
scope.empty: Nothing is scoped into this release yet. Add the work it is meant to deliver so "ready" means something.
scope.noneAvailable: Every open task on this product is already in a release.

panel.title: Releases
panel.subtitle: The cycles this product ships in.
panel.empty: No releases yet. Plan one to give the next batch of work a date and a checklist.

form.name: Name
form.notesPlaceholder: What changed, what to watch, what to tell users…

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.empty: This release has no required checks.
checklist.closed: The checklist is closed: this release has already shipped or been cancelled.
checklist.readOnly: Only the product owner or an admin can complete these.

release_notes.label: Release notes written
release_notes.hint: What changed, in language the people affected can read.

qa_signoff.label: QA sign-off
qa_signoff.hint: Someone other than the author has exercised the change.

rollback_plan.label: Rollback plan
rollback_plan.hint: How this gets undone, written down before it is needed.

security_signoff.label: Security sign-off
security_signoff.hint: Required for high-risk products. The review is recorded in the lifecycle.

change_approval.label: Change approval
change_approval.hint: Required for high-risk products. Who agreed this goes out, and when.

advance.title: Move this release
advance.gapsRecorded: This is recorded against the release rather than blocking it.
advance.waiverRequired: A high-risk release cannot ship with gaps unless you write down why.
advance.waiverPlaceholder: Why this ships with the gaps above, and what covers the risk…
advance.openTasks: {count, plural, =1 {1 task still open} other {# tasks still open}}

confirm.planned: Send this release back to planning.
confirm.in_progress: Work on this release is under way.
confirm.ready: Everything is in place and this is ready to go out.
confirm.released: This is going out. The checklist and any gaps are recorded against it permanently.
confirm.rolled_back: This release was pulled back after going out. The record of it shipping is kept.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid: Check the release details and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the product owner or an admin can do that.
errors.adminRequired: High-risk products need an admin for this.
errors.notFound: The release could not be found.
errors.duplicateVersion: That version already exists for this product.
errors.invalidTransition: A release cannot move straight to that status.
errors.checklistClosed: This release has shipped or been cancelled; its checklist is closed.
errors.releasedImmutable: A released version cannot be deleted.
errors.waiverRequired: Write down why this ships with gaps.
